credits.title: The Mongoose
credits.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

credits.title: Play Dirty
credits.overview: Expert thief Parker gets a shot at a major heist, but to pull it off he and his team must outsmart a South American dictator, the New York mob, and the world's richest man.

credits.title: All Hallows' Eve: Inferno
credits.overview: From an executive producer of Terrifier 2 comes All Hallows Eve: Inferno, a new installment of the franchise that first introduced the world to Damien Leone's Art the Clown and the short film Terrifier. credits.title: Aftertaste
credits.overview: Following the death of her mysterious grandma, her Amah, a young chef is haunted during her first night of service at a Michelin star kitchen.
